title: excoecaria klotzschii
intro: Excoecaria klotzschii, commonly known as Poison Tree or Electric Tree, is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae. It is native to tropical Africa and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Excoecaria klotzschii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of Excoecaria klotzschii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
